title: The component locus of a smooth section is stable under generalization
statement: Let g:P→T be a smooth [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms], quasi-compact, quasi-separated morphism of schemes, and let σ:T→P satisfy σ≫g=id_T. Put C={p∈P | p lies in the connected component of σ(g(p)) in the subspace g⁻¹({g(p)})}. If p specializes to q and q∈C, then p∈C.

proof.text: At the special point x choose an open neighbourhood W and a smooth noetherian model with component membership equivalence.

Because W is open and y specializes to x, y also belongs to W. Lift both points to W; subtype specialization agrees with ambient specialization. Continuity of the model morphism maps this specialization to the model.
Transfer x membership to the model, apply the noetherian specialization theorem there, and transfer y membership back.
